expectations.text: The reply reports the uncaught JSON parse error (SyntaxError) captured from the page console or page errors after the click
expectations.evidence: The reply says that clicking the button in headless Chromium threw "Expected ',' or '}' after property value in JSON at position 12 (line 1 column 13)" and that `JSON.parse` throws a `SyntaxError`.

expectations.text: The reply names the malformed JSON literal (missing closing brace) as the cause
expectations.evidence: The reply quotes `JSON.parse('{"total": 12');` at app.html:5 and says "The JSON string is missing its closing `}`."
